armor:
Use case stylized-concept. Make a non-weapon fantasy inventory gear modular concept sheet using attached image as STRICT STYLE REFERENCE only. Match its extremely simple chunky pixel art, large hard square pixels, roughly 16x16 logical pixels per icon, 3-5 flat colors per item, no antialiasing, no gradient, no texture, no detailed rendering. All items are standalone objects, no character, body, mannequin, face, hands, or scene. Flat dark charcoal background. Clear readable labels. Title "GEAR / MODULAR VARIATIONS".
Exactly 4 ROWS x 5 COLUMNS with header labels "BASE", "MATERIAL", "QUALITY", "PREFIX", "SUFFIX". Each row is a cumulative progression: preserve previous changes while adding next one. Same silhouette and scale throughout each row, aside from tiny intended affix details.
Row 1 HEAD, simple front-facing open helm with dark empty face opening. BASE gray Steel helm, tiny brown lining. MATERIAL pale blue Mithril helm, brown lining unchanged. QUALITY Masterwork adds a simple yellow rim 3 pixels. PREFIX Enchanted adds one purple forehead gem and two tiny violet square sparks. SUFFIX of Intelligence adds a purple 2-pixel temple inset; keep gem and gold rim. Cell captions "Steel Helm", "Mithril", "Masterwork", "Enchanted", "Intelligence".
Row 2 CHEST, front-facing sleeveless simple breastplate with dark neckline, two brown side straps. BASE gray Steel breastplate. MATERIAL warm Bronze main plates, straps stay brown. QUALITY Battle Scarred adds two dark square dents on bronze. PREFIX Reinforced adds small gray corner plates on shoulders. SUFFIX of Protection adds small blue 3-pixel central clasp while preserving bronze and scars. Captions "Steel Plate", "Bronze", "Battle Scarred", "Reinforced", "Protection".
Row 3 LEGS, simple pair of gray shinguards connected by a plain brown waist belt, empty space between legs, no human legs. BASE gray Steel shinguards. MATERIAL ivory Bone shin plates, brown belt unchanged. QUALITY Worn adds one missing edge pixel and faded belt pixel. PREFIX Sturdy adds brown strap bands to each shin. SUFFIX of Strength adds a tiny ochre square belt buckle. Captions "Steel Guards", "Bone", "Worn", "Sturdy", "Strength".
Row 4 FEET, single simple side-view short boot with clearly visible toe and sole. BASE gray Steel plated boot, dark brown sole. MATERIAL dark plum Obsidian shell, brown sole unchanged. QUALITY Heirloom adds 2 muted brass cuff pixels and burgundy ankle band. PREFIX Nimble adds two mint ribbon pixels at back cuff. SUFFIX of Agility adds a tiny mint buckle at ankle; retain ribbon and brass cuff. Captions "Steel Boot", "Obsidian", "Heirloom", "Nimble", "Agility".
Keep ALL artwork genuinely minimalist like tiny actual RPG sprites enlarged, no detailed trim, no ornamental engravings, no realistic armor. Use large countable pixels. Components must stay visually separate: shell/lining, plate/strap, guards/belt, boot/sole. Column 5 must retain earlier material/quality/prefix choices. Artwork is visual concept not UI screenshot.
softGear:
Use case stylized-concept. Create a second non-weapon inventory concept sheet showing soft gear, STRICTLY matching the attached approved extremely minimalist chunky pixel art. Actual tiny 16x16-style icons enlarged with countable large hard square pixels. No realistic detail, no textures, no dithering, no smooth gradients, no antialiasing. 3-5 colors per item. Flat charcoal background and clearly readable labels. No character bodies or mannequins.
Title "SOFT GEAR / AFFIX STUDY". Grid 4 rows x 4 columns. Column headers "BASE", "QUALITY", "PREFIX", "SUFFIX". Cumulative left-to-right changes, preserve prior changes.
Row 1: simple blue CLOTH HOOD with dark empty face opening, brown tie. Col1 label "Hood"; Col2 "Worn" one missing hem pixel and faded edge; Col3 "Enchanted" one purple clasp and two small isolated violet spark squares; Col4 "Intelligence" two purple embroidered pixels on forehead. Keep blue cloth and worn edge throughout.
Row 2: simple brown LEATHER COAT, short sleeves, dark front seam, tan belt. Col1 "Coat"; Col2 "Battle Scarred" two tiny dark scratches; Col3 "Reinforced" gray 2-pixel shoulder plates; Col4 "Protection" blue square belt buckle. Keep brown leather, belt, scratches and reinforcing plates.
Row 3: simple muted green CLOTH TROUSERS, brown waist band, two short legs and dark gap. Col1 "Trousers"; Col2 "Second Hand" one tan square knee patch; Col3 "Nimble" two mint pixels dangling from waistband; Col4 "Agility" tiny mint belt buckle while retaining knee patch and ribbon. All leg lengths remain equal.
Row 4: one simple side-view brown LEATHER SHOE, darker sole. Col1 "Shoe"; Col2 "Heirloom" two muted brass lace pixels; Col3 "Swift" two isolated pale blue trailing square pixels behind heel; Col4 "Vitality" tiny pink plus at heel. Retain brown leather, dark sole, brass laces and blue speed pixels.
Each sprite extremely simple, almost pictogram level. Shared silhouette within each row. Do not turn cloth or leather into metal. Effects only 2-3 pixels. No ornate embroidery. Do not add weapons. This sheet tests how affixes use hems, patches, seams, straps, buckles and small effects. Labels exactly as given.
